import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static int[] arr;
    static int n;
    static int itv;

    static int Get(int pos) {
        int ret = 0;
        int bound = arr[pos] + itv;
        for (int i = pos; i < n; ++i) {
            if (arr[i] <= bound)
                ++ret;
        }
        return ret;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        arr = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            arr[i] = sc.nextInt();
        Arrays.sort(arr);
        itv = sc.nextInt();
        int ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            ans = Math.max(ans, Get(i));
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
